newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MMK sees higher group oper profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: MMK sees higher group oper profit in 1997.

text.p: Austrian cardboard manufacturer Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG said on Tuesday it expects to raise group operating profit for 1997 to one billion schillings from the 0.77 billion schillings posted last year.

"We are very optimistic on the second half of the year -- traditionally the weaker half. An operating profit of one billion schillings (for the full year) should be attainable," board chairman Michael Groeller told journalists at MMK's first-half earnings conference.
"An operating profit of one billion schillings over the year is definitely in sight", said Wilhelm Hvrmanseder, also a member of the board.
MMK aims to pay a good dividend, board chairman Michael Groeller said, declining to give more details. For 1996, MMK paid a dividend of 17 schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
